entries.title: device_disconnected after a client-initiated disconnect_device
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events.items[device_disconnected] fixes the payload {node_id, reason}, but nothing in the contract says a client-initiated disconnect must push it
entries.expected: no pass/fail is possible: the contract constrains the shape but not the occurrence
entries.actual: the contract constrains the event's shape, never when it must be emitted  observed: no device_disconnected event followed the client's own disconnect_device

entries.actual: 0 event(s) received, names seen: (none)

entries.actual: 0 event(s), none carrying an id

entries.title: every event that did arrive carries the payload shape the contract declares for it
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events.items[].payload
entries.expected: 0 conforming event payloads
entries.actual: 0 event(s), every declared payload key present and correctly typed

entries.title: which of the contract's five events this host pushed during the sweep
entries.contract_citation: contract.yaml events fixes the closed set and each payload shape, but attaches no event to a capability id; gap_generation computes gaps over capabilities only, so a host that pushes no events can neither declare that as a gap nor be failed for it
entries.expected: no pass/fail is possible: the contract constrains the shape but not the occurrence
entries.actual: event occurrence is unconstrained by the contract, so silence is not a verdict  observed: pushed during this sweep: [(none)]; not pushed: [component_added, component_removed, property_changed, property_descriptor_changed, device_disconnected]
